title: Braised Pork Cheek
notes: For a dinner party, the accompaniments and steps 1-7 can be done in advance and the cheeks can be reheated in the braising liquid.

methodSections.heading: Sunchoke Purée
steps: Peel, roughly chop and then simmer the sunchoke in the milk, vegetable stock, thyme, whole garlic cloves and black peppercorns until soft.
Transfer the sunchoke to a blender and purée, adding some of the liquid as necessary to achieve a smooth texture.

methodSections.heading: Hazelnut Gremolata
steps: Toast the hazelnuts in a hot oven, 200°C (400°F), for 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven, allow to cool slightly and then crush or chop into a crumble.
Chop the parsley, zest the lemons and grate the cheese.
Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl.

methodSections.heading: Roasted Sunchokes
steps: Peel the sunchokes and chop into 2-3cm (1in) pieces. Finely chop the garlic and remove the stalks from the thyme.
Toss together all the ingredients, ensuring the sunchokes are coated in the oil.
Arrange the sunchokes evenly on an oven tray and roast for 40-45 minutes or until tender.

methodSections.heading: Braised Pork Cheek
steps: Clean all sinew and silver skin from cheeks, salt lightly and rest in the fridge overnight.

Rinse the cheeks and then season lightly with salt and pepper. Sear in a hot pan with a splash of oil. Remove from pan and allow to cool. Place the cheeks on a cheesecloth and tie it into a closed bag.

Roughly chop and then sauté the onion, carrot and celery in a splash of canola oil until everything starts to colour. Roughly chop the garlic, add it to the vegetables and cook an additional 3-5 minutes.
Add and stir through the tomato paste and cook until it starts to stick to the pan. Deglaze with the red wine and sherry vinegar.
Add the black peppercorns and the thyme, reduce the heat
